Run the Pimoroni Enviro app

Source: R/run_app.R
pimoroni.Rd

Starts a Shiny app with the readings of Pimoroni Enviro and Enviro+ sensors exported to Prometheus: gauges with the latest readings in the Current tab, and a chart per sensor in the Time Series tab. The app has a dark mode, switched by the button at the right of the navbar.

Usage

pimoroni(
  prometheus_url,
  timezone = "Europe/Bucharest",
  analytics = FALSE,
  onStart = NULL,
  options = list(),
  enableBookmarking = NULL,
  uiPattern = "/",
  ...
)

Arguments

prometheus_url

Character vector of Prometheus query_range urls, one per device, such as "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range".

timezone

The time zone the readings are shown in, while the app runs.

analytics

TRUE to add Google Analytics, through the cookie banner shared with the sites of sedzinfo.github.io, which loads it only after the visitor accepts. Meant for the public deployment (see app.R); off by default, so that running the app yourself sends nothing.

onStart

See shiny::shinyApp().

options

See shiny::shinyApp().

enableBookmarking

See shiny::shinyApp().

uiPattern

See shiny::shinyApp().

...

Further options passed to golem::with_golem_options().

Value

A shiny::shinyApp() object. Printing it, or calling pimoroni() at the console, opens the app in the browser.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  pimoroni(prometheus_url = c(
    "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1507/api/v1/query_range",
    "http://pip1.crabdance.com:1505/api/v1/query_range"
  ))
}
